name: Add a frontend shortcode with its own CSS and JS
query: Add a [promo_banner] shortcode that renders a frontend widget. The widget needs its own stylesheet and JavaScript file. Follow the boilerplate pattern for public-facing code.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run detect_wpboilerplate.mjs to confirm isWPBoilerplate: true
Step 2: Consult references/public.md to confirm all frontend classes belong under public/ with namespace ...\Public
Step 3: Create public/PromoBanner.php with namespace WordPress_Plugin_Boilerplate\Public
Step 4: Add source files src/js/promo-banner.js and src/scss/promo-banner.scss
Step 5: Consult references/build-system.md; add the new entry point to webpack.config.js entry: block
Step 6: Run npm run build to generate build/js/promo-banner.js and build/js/promo-banner.asset.php
Step 7: In PromoBanner enqueue method, read version and dependencies from build/js/promo-banner.asset.php — never hardcode
Step 8: In includes/Main.php::define_public_hooks(), instantiate PromoBanner and register hooks via Loader
success_criteria: New class is under public/ with correct namespace
Source JS and SCSS go in src/, not build/
Asset version and dependencies read from *.asset.php manifest — no hardcoded version strings
composer dump-autoload is mentioned or run
